CommunitySubmission.title: CommunitySubmission
CommunitySubmission.description: User-submitted scout spot or hidden gem uploaded from offline drafts

PrivateSpotNote.title: PrivateSpotNote
PrivateSpotNote.description: Private scout note for one spot, stored under the owner's own UID path and never included in public community submissions

CommunityTip.title: CommunityTip
CommunityTip.description: Community tip or peer status update for a scout spot

SpotPhoto.title: SpotPhoto
SpotPhoto.description: Registered community photo metadata, written only by the trusted finalizePhotoUpload Cloud Function after the referenced Storage object has been verified

moderationState.description: Set to "removed" by the trusted moderateReportedPhotos scheduled sweep once the report threshold is reached

moderatedAt.description: Server-side wall time (ms) at which the record was marked removed

/community_submissions/{submissionId}.description: Public community submissions and discovered hidden gems synchronized from offline drafts. Must never contain private scout notes — Firestore has no field-level access control

/users/{uid}/private_spot_notes/{spotId}.description: Owner-scoped private scout notes: readable and writable only by the authenticated owner (uid); cross-user access is denied by firestore.rules

/community_tips/{tipId}.description: Community tips, insights, and peer status updates for scout spots

/spot_photos/{photoId}.description: Publicly readable photo metadata; every client write is denied by firestore.rules — only the trusted Cloud Functions create or update these documents (registration at finalization, moderationState by the moderation sweep)

/spot_photos/{uid}/{spotId}/{filename}.description: Community photo objects. Publicly readable. Clients may create a new object at their own ownership path (image/jpeg or image/png, under 5 MB). Objects are immutable once written: overwrite (re-upload) is rejected by the create rule, and update and delete are denied for everyone — all removal happens through trusted backend functions (the scheduled orphan reaper and the moderation sweep), keeping Storage and Firestore consistent
